title: 第013章 剑中女帝第014章 灵器问世
content_zh:
轰！
叶炎体内，一道轰鸣响起，随后那灵剑内的灵力便是在‘天帝诀’功法下直接向着叶炎丹田而去。
咔嚓！
如此灵力之下，仅仅瞬间叶炎便感受到了那四重凝气境的屏障被破。
如今，他已是达到了五重凝气境。
然而一切还没有结束，在这灵剑内还有着更多的灵力没有被炼化。
“炼！”
叶炎暗道。
只是就在这一刻，叶炎身旁那父亲所留下的‘天帝剑’猛然一颤。
那身在叶炎体内的灵剑之力顿时被吸入到了‘天帝剑’内，随后此剑之上古老的纹路闪烁起来，其气息之强堪比中阶灵器！
而那灵剑化为废剑，杂质自叶炎体内排出。
这使得叶炎眉头一蹙，看向了天帝剑。
“这剑，掠夺了我的灵力？”叶炎无语。
若不然今日他绝对有着希望突破到七重凝气境，现在却只是停滞在了五重凝气境的层次上。
“终于苏醒了！”
就在此时，一道清脆如铃的声音响起。
这是一位女子在说话，而且这声音竟是有着一种雍容华贵之气，似是一代女帝在开口。
“谁？”
叶炎一惊，魂力顿时自魂丹内释放而出，萦绕四周。
“不用找了……”

这女子再度开口，这使得叶炎看向了那天帝剑。
是此剑在开口？
“是我！”天帝剑道。
“你是何人？”叶炎凝眉。
“何人？！”这声音沉默起来，似是在回忆古老的过往。
叶炎见其不答，一头黑线：“是你吸收了我的力量？”
“那灵剑之力你还没彻底炼化，严格来说那可不是你的力量。不过这等力量能够让我苏醒，你应该对我感激。”这女子道，旋即此剑光芒闪烁照耀在叶炎身上。
“万道帝体，世间唯一！”
“金色丹田，盖世无双！”
“魂力天赋，古今难比！”
“最重要的是毅力之强，世所罕见。怪不得你可修炼天帝诀能够唤醒我。”这女子喃喃。
叶炎眉头皱的更深，他竟是这般被看穿了？
“你究竟是谁，为何身在剑内？”叶炎再度问道。
只是女子依旧不答，但那光芒却已是再度笼罩了叶炎。
刹那间，叶炎便进入到了这天帝剑的世界之内。
依旧白茫茫的光华笼罩此地，只是此地的气息却更显得古老，那书架也是发生变化，之前只是对叶炎开放第一排而已，如今第二排也是开放。
其内的不少功法、武技，竟有着圣品中阶层次！
甚至还有圣品高阶！
这若是传出去，连云朝宗都要疯狂来争夺吧？
哗……

不过下一刻，一道身影则是出现了叶炎的面前。
这身影，身穿白衣，但却背对着叶炎。
content_en:
boom!
A roar rang out inside Ye Yan's body, and then the spiritual power in the spiritual sword went directly towards Ye Yan's dantian under the 'Heavenly Emperor's Art' technique.
Click!
Under such spiritual power, Ye Yan felt that the barrier of the fourth level of Qi Condensation was broken in just an instant.
Now, he has reached the fifth level of Qi Condensation.
However, everything is not over yet. There is still more spiritual power in this spiritual sword that has not been refined.
"Refining!"
Ye Yan secretly said.
But at this moment, the 'Celestial Emperor Sword' left by his father beside Ye Yan suddenly trembled.
The power of the spiritual sword in Ye Yan's body was immediately sucked into the 'Celestial Emperor Sword', and then the ancient lines on the sword flickered, and its aura was as powerful as a mid-level spiritual weapon!
The spiritual sword turned into a useless sword, and the impurities were discharged from Ye Yan's body.
This made Ye Yan frown and look at the Emperor Sword.
"This sword robbed me of my spiritual power?" Ye Yan was speechless.
Otherwise, today he definitely has hope of breaking through to the seventh level of Qi Condensation Realm, but now he is just stuck at the fifth level of Qi Condensation Realm.
"Finally woke up!"
At this moment, a sound as clear as a bell sounded.
This was a woman speaking, and her voice actually had a graceful and noble air, as if she was speaking from a generation of empress.
"Who?"
Ye Yan was startled, and the soul power was immediately released from the soul pill, lingering around.
"No need to look for it..."
The woman spoke again, which made Ye Yan look at Tiandi Sword.
Is this sword speaking?
"It's me!" Emperor Sword said.
"Who are you?" Ye Yan frowned.
"Who?!" The voice became silent, as if recalling the ancient past.
When Ye Yan didn't answer, he said with a black line: "Did you absorb my power?"
"You haven't completely refined the power of the spiritual sword. Strictly speaking, it's not your power. But this power can revive me, so you should be grateful to me." The woman said, and soon the sword's light shone on Ye Yan.
"The Emperor's Body of Ten Thousand Daos is the only one in the world!"
"The golden Dantian is unparalleled in the world!"
"The talent of soul power is unparalleled in ancient and modern times!"
"The most important thing is your strong perseverance, which is rare in the world. No wonder you can wake me up by practicing the Heavenly Emperor Technique." The woman murmured.
Ye Yan's brows furrowed even deeper, was he actually seen through like this?
"Who are you and why are you inside the sword?" Ye Yan asked again.
The woman still didn't answer, but the light enveloped Ye Yan again.
In an instant, Ye Yan entered the world of the Heavenly Emperor Sword.
The place is still shrouded in white light, but the atmosphere here seems more ancient. The bookshelf has also changed. Before, only the first row was open to Ye Yan, but now the second row is also open.
Many of the exercises and martial arts in it are actually at the middle level of the Saint Grade!
There are even high-level saints!
If word of this spreads, even Yun Chaozong will be crazy to fight for it, right?
Wow...
But the next moment, a figure appeared in front of Ye Yan.
This figure was wearing white clothes, but his back was to Ye Yan.
